hooks.command: gate="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bin/$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')-$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/;s/aarch64/arm64/')/permission-gate"; [ -x "$gate" ] || { echo "guardrails permission-gate: no executable gate binary for this platform at $gate -- failing closed, tool call denied. Build and commit one per plugins/guardrails/hooks/permission-gate/README.md." >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$gate"
